notes.title: Tempo clash
notes.text: Penn State wants to play fast (72.1 plays/game) while Ohio State grinds (67.3). Whoever grabs an early lead controls the clock.

notes.title: Scheme matchup
notes.text: Ohio State's pass-first plan (56% pass rate) runs into Penn State's blitz-heavy defense (36% blitz rate). Expect sacks and explosive plays, so a wider range of outcomes.
